notes.title: Windows Trojan Virus Warning Update
notes.notes:
Hi GPGP Steam!

It seems after the recent game update to 5.18.2 and higher, some players using a Windows PC have been receiving a Trojan Virus warning from attempting to run the game on their computer.

Unfortunately nothing in the game's settings have been changed - the only addition was the 10th year event which is in the exact same event format as all our others ran throughout the year. We suspect the warning may have been triggered from an update on Windows' side.

We have contacted the Windows support team and let them know of the issue, but still need help in better understanding the bug. If you have any video, more details, or have any other game that has similar issues, please let us know at pizza@tapblaze.com.

We will do our best to get to the bottom of this issue and have it fixed soon. Thank you for your support and understanding, Ovenists.

- TapBlaze Team

notes.title: Pizza Update 1.4
notes.notes:
Hello Master Ovenists!

Thank you for the long wait! The GPGP restaurant services are here to help repair and renovate your shop!

It’s been a while since our last update on Steam, but we definitely haven’t forgot you guys! Thank you for continuing to cook with us! We are hard at work at creating something special for our Steam Ovenists this year, as well as improving the overall game, adding mini-events, and prepping for a Chapter 4. Please stay tuned, and we promise to bring more flavors for you to taste!

Version 1.4.0.5 is available now for all players!

Bug Fixes

 Achievements: The game should have no problems unlocking any of the achievements now.(Finally!) If you had any past achievements that didn’t unlock, please check your ‘Achievements’ app in the MyPad, and click on the yellow ‘Sync’ button on your top-right corner to have them unlocked!
 Crashes: We have fixed the game crashes for Asian languages on Windows. The game should run smoothly for all languages across all platforms now!
 Game Launch: We fixed the launch bug for our Window Players. The game should now launch in under a minute across all platforms!
 Minor order changes and error fixes


New

 If you buy an item from the shop at night, the delivery man will drop it off in the morning! 
 Receipt items will appear one by one, instead of popping up altogether. (Kind of like a real printing receipt)


Improvements

 The rent will be collected every 3 days from now! Even if you trash a couple pizzas or sleep through an entire day, you have 2 more days to make $30! (First rent collected in Day 4)
 Smushed the cheese and pepperoni pizza tutorial to Day 1. Alicante will now give you money to buy the tip jar! (He is some sort of weird philanthropist!)  Landlord is introduced on Day 3, along with the oven mechanic from Owen’s Ovens. (Have an oven, and the first booster is on us!)


If you still see the same bugs or any new issues, please let us know at our DISCORD Server for the fastest reply, or make a discussion thread in our social media! You could also press ‘Contact’ in your game settings to reach us!

Thank you, and happy cooking!
